title: Lower the complete compiler checkpoint stream to a fixed-tape dispatcher with permanent owned homes
body:
## Result
Expand the frozen #7423/#7348/#7347/#7346 source codecs through all native checkpoints and lower them to physical permanent-home routing. Full dispatcher cost is 16(R+1)(K+b+1)(F+2), plus every primitive; entry history and all retired homes remain charged. Productive normalization is V/B.

## Evidence and limits
33 fixtures, 10 rejecting controls, source binding, matched-slot chronology and a separate sparse-tape interpreter pass. Reproduce verify.py and review/check_physical.py in research/compiler-permanent-home-dispatch. Supplied native identities, typed initialization, complete format and compatible primitive ABI remain premises. No full selected word, assumption discharge or new kappa.

Base: e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Credit: @CubeJerry and the predecessors in NOTICE.md; substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

[Full proof, exact pins, checks and proposed description](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b4fcc9d64971fdabd0b1d82cfb749d8aac920437/research/compiler-permanent-home-dispatch/PR.md)
